domain.name: inv_single
domain.one_line: Single-echelon periodic-review inventory with stochastic lead time and backlogging.

state_variables.name: period
state_variables.desc: current period t; horizon ends when period == T

state_variables.name: inventory
state_variables.desc: net on-hand inventory after all period events; read by next transition

state_variables.name: pipeline
state_variables.desc: pipeline[k] = quantity arriving at the k-th future R (receive) event; read by next R

placement.rationale: no later transition reads it; exposed to the agent only via the vec_d observation mode

info_fields.name: leadtime
info_fields.desc: sampled lead time of this period's order

info_fields.name: action_period
info_fields.desc: period the emitting decision was taken (boundary invariant)

decisions.name: order

type.rationale: 'how much to order' stated no integrality; continuous is easier for PPO

bounds.rationale: 20x mean demand; upper bound caps the action scale, not a physical limit. Symbolic so each demand candidate resizes to its own scale.

decisions.desc: replenishment quantity placed at the O (order) event

updates: if not allow_backlog: lost_sales = max(0, -inventory); inventory = max(0, inventory)

per_step_components.name: holding
per_step_components.desc: evaluated at END_OF_PERIOD on end-of-period inventory

per_step_components.name: shortage
per_step_components.expr: b * max(0, -inventory) if allow_backlog else b * lost_sales
per_step_components.desc: evaluated at END_OF_PERIOD: on end-of-period backlog, or on this period's lost sales in the lost-sales variant

constants.name: h
constants.desc: holding cost per unit of positive end-of-period stock

constants.name: b
constants.desc: shortage cost per unit of backlog

constants.name: allow_backlog
constants.desc: unmet demand accumulates as negative inventory (vs lost sales)

constants.name: demand_support_size
constants.desc: discrete candidate: number of support points in the per-episode demand distribution

constants.name: demand_support_low
constants.desc: discrete candidate: lowest integer the per-episode support is drawn from

constants.name: demand_support_high
constants.desc: discrete candidate: highest integer the per-episode support is drawn from

constants.name: demand_alpha
constants.desc: poisson candidate: Gamma shape of the hidden Poisson rate; E[lambda] = alpha/beta = 30

constants.name: demand_beta
constants.desc: poisson candidate: Gamma rate of the hidden Poisson rate; sd[lambda] = sqrt(alpha)/beta = 10

discrete.desc: per-episode discrete demand distribution: a support of demand_support_size integers drawn without replacement from [demand_support_low, demand_support_high] with normalized-uniform weights (hidden world latent)

poisson.desc: Poisson demand with hidden per-episode rate lambda ~ Gamma(demand_alpha, demand_beta) (shape-rate; the conjugate prior for a Poisson rate)

discrete.desc: stochastic lead time on a fixed discrete support

action_modes.name: order
action_modes.desc: identity: the agent emits the order quantity directly, clipped into bounds

reward_modes.name: neg_cost
reward_modes.desc: negated per-step cost.total (sense=minimize, reward is maximized)

requires_memory.rationale: hidden world latent (per-episode demand distribution) suggests memory; overridden to reactive for the baseline pipeline

obs_normalization.rationale: inventory and pipeline entries are stationary features of heterogeneous magnitude (scale set by the selected demand candidate); spec §8.3 says normalize

assumptions_log: Order quantity modeled as continuous (float) and clipped to [0, 20*demand.mean]; the source description said 'how much to order' without specifying integrality.
Initial inventory and pipeline assumed empty (0).
Unmet demand is backlogged (allow_backlog=true); the lost-sales variant is the 'lost_sales' scenario instance (allow_backlog=false).
Cost components are evaluated at END_OF_PERIOD on end-of-period inventory.
`demand` placed in info (not state): no later transition reads it; it is exposed to the agent only via the vec_d observation mode.
Period indexing is 0-based; horizon T=30; reaching T is `terminated` (T is part of the problem, no bootstrapping past it), not `truncated`.

DEMAND CANDIDATES (catalog): 'discrete' (default) draws a hidden per-episode 3-point distribution; 'poisson' draws a hidden per-episode rate lambda ~ Gamma(9, 0.3). Selected per instance ('poisson', 'poisson_lost_sales') or via --select demand=poisson; scale-derived bounds resolve per selection from the derived demand.mean (10 vs 30).

Seed scheme v2 (spec §6.3): intrinsic draws key [period, slot_stream_id, 1, episode_seed, seed_salt]; each slot's world latents draw on the meta branch at the SAME slot stream_id ([stream_id, 0, episode_seed, seed_salt]), so instances sharing a candidate share latent draws (common random numbers across instances).
